# Synthetic face test data

`face-synthetic.png` contains two entirely fictional AI-generated adults. It contains no student records or real reference photographs. Generated with the built-in imagegen tool on 17 November 2026, inspected visually, and copied into this workspace for development-only face-model acceptance. Do not import it into an operator enrollment gallery.

Prompt: Create one 1536 by 1024 scientific computer-vision test contact sheet divided into two equal 768 by 1024 portrait panels, plain neutral gray background. Each panel shows a completely fictional synthetic adult, frontal neutral expression, head and upper shoulders, eyes open, no glasses or hats, realistic even photographic lighting and clear landmarks. Left: middle-aged adult with short dark hair, broad nose, clean-shaven oval face. Right: distinctly different older adult with short curly gray hair, narrow face, small nose. No text, real people, celebrities, or logos.

The fixture supports same-image, transformed-image, different-image, and multiple-face regression checks. Two generated identities cannot establish real-world biometric accuracy, demographic fairness, or resistance to photographs/videos.
